thread:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — capturing owners, timelines, and the weekly cadence for remediation work. I pulled the main action items into one thread so we can track. Please ack and add deadlines or blockers.

ashley: Ack. I can own automated token validation tests and add a synthetic to catch regressions. Target: end of next sprint.

kevin: I'll take audit log ingestion reliability & schema validation. Will open schema PR and a follow-up ticket for alerting. aiming for 2 weeks.

priya: I can drive secrets rotation automation (k8s + vault) and add a playbook for emergency rotation. Need a day to sketch the steps, 3 weeks to finish automation.

ben: I'll tie these into the runbook and oncall checklist. Where should I put the runbook updates?

morgan: Put runbook edits here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/authz-response (team-only). Ben pls add a short TL;DR at top and a 'rollback' section.

ashley: Adding initial checklist here (WIP):
- token validation unit + e2e tests : owner ashley : due 2026-04-08
- runtime token hardening (reject malformed claims) : owner ashley/eng-runtime : due 2026-04-15
- audit log schema + alerts : owner kevin : due 2026-04-01
- secrets rotation automation + runbook : owner priya : due 2026-04-22
- post-change smoke jobs on deploy : owner ben : due 2026-04-05

kevin: For audit logs, I'll add an ingestion validator that rejects incomplete events and emits metrics to datadog. Example validator snippet:```python
def validate_event(evt):
    required = ["user_id","token_id","action","ts"]
    return all(k in evt for k in required)
```
I'll attach test vectors in the ticket.

priya: For rotation automation I'm thinking cron + k8s job + vault API. Minimal example cron we can start with:```bash
# weekly rotation job (example)
0 3 * * 1 /usr/local/bin/rotate-secrets --env prod --dry-run
```
We'll add dry-run, notification, and fast rollback.

oncall-bot: Reminder: schedule weekly follow-up created by morgan.

morgan: Can we make these recurring tasks on the remediation board and add owners? I'll create the epics and link tickets. Also want a weekly 30m sync until all items closed. Proposed cadence: Tuesdays 10:00am PT.

ben: SGTM. I'll update the runbook and add the calendar series. Also will add a small section "Detecting recurrence" with common symptoms we saw (partial token rejects, dropped audit events, delayed rotations).

ashley: One more ask — can infra enable a short retention window for detailed audit logs (2 weeks) for quicker debugging? I'll file a req.

devops-bot: New ticket created: AUTHZ-1487 (audit log retention increase), assigned to infra-team.

morgan: Great. Action owner recap: ashley (token tests + hardening), kevin (audit ingestion + alerts), priya (rotation automation + playbook), ben (runbook + oncall checklist). Target: interim check-in next Tues 10am PT. If anyone needs more time, flag now. :white_check_mark:

kevin: ack — I'll post status before the sync with links to PRs/tickets.

priya: ack, will post the initial playbook draft by EOD Friday.

ashley: ack, starting test plan today.

morgan: Thanks all — I'll drop the calendar invite and link the sprint epics.
